correctness.rationale: Finite-rank cutoffs on the finitely many high-weight image fibers give the upper approximation bound. Separated peak functions produce exact finite-dimensional lower witnesses for approximation, Bernstein, Gelfand and Kolmogorov numbers. Infinite threshold images yield isometric c0 witnesses, which give the matching distances to compact, weakly compact, FSS and SS classes.

originality.rationale: Classical compactness/weak-compactness criteria and the exact essential norm on C(X) are explicitly treated as prior art. The consulted literature did not identify the simultaneous four-s-number finite-index profile, the exact weakly-compact/FSS/SS distances, or the quantitative isometric-c0 witness. Older surveys, monographs and disjointness-preserver literature remain a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: One counting-threshold invariant determines four standard s-number sequences and, at the limit, four operator-ideal distances. The result also gives a concrete c0 mechanism explaining all noncompact cases.
